homepage.title: Mobile Developer : Android | IOS | Kotlin | Flutter | Kotlin Multiplatform | Java
homepage.description:
Mid-level Developer focused on Android and mobile technologies, specialized in Kotlin, Java, and Flutter. I have solid experience in developing native applications for Android and wearables, using Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Retrofit, and Samsung Health SDK, in addition to implementing CI/CD practices, monitoring, and data analysis to ensure high quality and performance.

 I complement my mobile performance with Back-End development in Spring Boot (Java) and Python (FastAPI/Flask), creating scalable RESTful APIs and microservices with Docker and Kubernetes. I have knowledge in data analysis with Python, physiological signal processing with NeuroKit, and application of Graph Theory in connectivity and optimization solutions.
